description: 固定两官方查询后仅实际返回两原解读URL各一次无凭据GET，保存原响应/hash，0重试；不接过期代理，不拟合。
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from urllib.parse import urlparse
import json,re,hashlib,unicodedata
import requests
ROOT=Path.cwd();R='reports/research/510300_equal_production_official_interpretation_source_v1';OUT=ROOT/R
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def save(name,obj):
 p=OUT/name;assert not p.exists(),'已有文件不覆盖：'+name
 p.write_text(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
def norm(s):return re.sub(r'\s+','',unicodedata.normalize('NFKC',s))
proto=json.loads((OUT/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
for x in proto['parents']:assert sha(ROOT/x['path'])==x['sha256'],x['path']
objects=[{'stat_month':'2024-08','url':'https://www.stats.gov.cn/xxgk/jd/sjjd2020/202408/t20240831_1956159.html','query_actual_title':'国家统计局服务业调查中心高级统计师赵庆河解读2024年8月中国采购经理指数'},
{'stat_month':'2025-04','url':'https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/sjjd/202504/t20250430_1959518.html','query_actual_title':'国家统计局服务业调查中心高级统计师赵庆河解读2025年4月中国采购经理指数'}]
save('实际官方目标URL_GET前登记.json',{'registered_at':now(),'objects':objects,'source':'固定官方两查询实际返回标题和URL，不从编号/地址规律猜测','query_content_already_observed':True,'parent_query_sha256':sha(OUT/'官方两次查询_完整结果.json'),'max_raw_GETs':2,'max_retries':0,'new_model_fits':0})
(OUT/'raw').mkdir(exist_ok=False)
session=requests.Session();session.trust_env=False
records=[]
for x in objects:
 assert urlparse(x['url']).hostname=='www.stats.gov.cn'
 receipt={**x,'request_started_at':now(),'authenticated':False,'project_provider_used':False,'redirects_enabled':False,'retries':0}
 try:
  response=session.get(x['url'],timeout=(8,20),allow_redirects=False)
  p=OUT/'raw'/('month_'+x['stat_month']+'.html');assert not p.exists();p.write_bytes(response.content)
  receipt.update(http_status=response.status_code,received_at=now(),response_bytes=len(response.content),resolved_url=response.url,raw_path=str(p.relative_to(ROOT)).replace('\\','/'),raw_sha256=sha(p),content_type=response.headers.get('content-type'),location=response.headers.get('location'),status='RAW_ORIGINAL_RECEIVED' if response.status_code==200 else 'UNAVAILABLE_HTTP_STATUS')
  if response.status_code==200:
   soup=BeautifulSoup(response.content,'html.parser')
   for node in soup.select('script,style'):node.decompose()
   text=soup.get_text('\n',strip=True);(OUT/'raw'/('month_'+x['stat_month']+'.txt')).write_text(text,encoding='utf-8')
   receipt['page_title']=soup.title.get_text(' ',strip=True) if soup.title else None
   compact=norm(text)
   title=norm(x['query_actual_title'])
   receipt['expected_title_matches']=title in compact
   pars=[norm(n.get_text(' ',strip=True)) for n in soup.find_all('p') if norm(n.get_text(' ',strip=True))]
   content=[v for v in pars if len(v)>=12 and any(w in v for w in ['制造业','PMI','生产指数','需求','环境','高温','多雨','关税'])]
   receipt['candidate_body_paragraphs']=list(dict.fromkeys(content))
   receipt['published_at_candidates']=list(dict.fromkeys(re.findall(r'\d{4}[/-]\d{2}[/-]\d{2}\s+\d{2}:\d{2}(?::\d{2})?',text)))
   receipt['declared_creation_date_candidates']=list(dict.fromkeys(re.findall(r'(?:成文日期|发布日期|发布时间)\s*(\d{4}年\d{1,2}月\d{1,2}日)',compact)))
   receipt['html_metadata']= [{'name':n.get('name'),'content':n.get('content')} for n in soup.find_all('meta') if n.get('name') in ['PubDate','ColumnName','ArticleTitle','ContentSource','Author']]
 except requests.RequestException as exc:
  receipt.update(status='UNAVAILABLE_TRANSPORT',received_at=now(),error_type=type(exc).__name__,error=str(exc))
 records.append(receipt);save('原GET_'+x['stat_month']+'_实际收件.json',receipt)
session.close()
save('原官方两月收件.json',records)
for x in proto['parents']:assert sha(ROOT/x['path'])==x['sha256']
for x in records:
 print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in x.items() if k in ['stat_month','url','http_status','status','response_bytes','raw_sha256','page_title','expected_title_matches','published_at_candidates','declared_creation_date_candidates','html_metadata','candidate_body_paragraphs','error']},ensure_ascii=False))
